woful.definition:
a. Full of woe; sorrowful; distressed with grief or calamity;
   afflicted; wretched; unhappy; sad.
a. Bringing calamity, distress, or affliction; as, a woeful
   event; woeful want.
a. Wretched; paltry; miserable; poor.
woful.translation: a. 悲伤的, 不幸的

wofully.definition:
adv. In a woeful manner; sorrowfully; mournfully; miserably;
   dolefully.

wofulness.definition:
n. The quality or state of being woeful; misery;
   wretchedness.
